alt:/_astro/greshams-law.CJndb_Dn_zMoho.webp|Hand-drawn supply-and-demand diagram of Gresham's Law as a price control: gold's supply and demand would clear at the market ratio (marked 16, "voluntary exchange"), but the Coinage Act of 1792 fixes the ratio at 15 by law ("legislative guns"), a price ceiling that drives the underpriced gold into shortage.
